segments.ja159:1.1: Udetayaṃ cakkhumā ekarājā, harissavaṇṇo pathavippabhāso [paṭhavippabhāso (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja159:3.3: Taṃ taṃ namassāmi harissavaṇṇaṃ pathavippabhāsaṃ, tayājja guttā viharemu divasaṃ. Ye brāhmaṇā vedagū sabbadhamme, te me namo te ca maṃ pālayantu; Namatthu buddhānaṃ [buddhāna (?)] namatthu bodhiyā, namo vimuttānaṃ [vimuttāna (?)] namo vimuttiyā; Imaṃ so parittaṃ katvā, moro carati esanā. Apetayaṃ cakkhumā ekarājā, harissavaṇṇo pathavippabhāso;
segments.ja159:3.4: Taṃ taṃ nammassāmi harissavaṇṇaṃ pathavippabhāsaṃ, tayājja guttā viharemu rattiṃ.
segments.ja159:4.1: Ye brāhmaṇā vedagū sabbadhamme, te me namo te ca maṃ pālayantu;
segments.ja159:4.3: Namatthu buddhānaṃ namatthu bodhiyā, namo vimuttānaṃ namo vimuttiyā;
segments.ja159:4.5: Imaṃ so parittaṃ katvā, moro vāsamakappayīti.
